game_saves_ui.title: Game Saves
game_saves_ui.subtitle: Find the saves of every game on this PC, back them up and bring them back.
game_saves_ui.database_offline: Could not check for a newer database, so the saved copy was used.
game_saves_ui.backup_folder_desc: One folder per game. Put it in a cloud folder to keep a copy off this PC.
game_saves_ui.folder_unavailable: This folder cannot be reached right now. Is its drive connected?
game_saves_ui.cloud_missing: That cloud folder was not found.
game_saves_ui.auto_desc: Windows starts the app in the background, backs up new and changed saves, and closes it again.
game_saves_ui.schedule_missing: The scheduled task is missing. Press Save to create it again.
game_saves_ui.schedule_dev: Automatic backups can only be scheduled from the installed or portable app.
game_saves_ui.schedule_portable_warning: This portable copy is in Downloads or Temp. If it is moved or deleted, automatic backups stop.
game_saves_ui.schedule_failed: Could not create the scheduled task: {error}
game_saves_ui.last_run_never: No automatic backup has run yet.
game_saves_ui.run_now: Back up new and changed saves now
game_saves_ui.run_nothing: Every save was already backed up.
game_saves_ui.roots_desc: Steam, Epic, GOG and Ubisoft games are found automatically. For games installed anywhere else, add the folder they are installed in.
game_saves_ui.add_game_folder: Add a folder where games are installed
game_saves_ui.launchers_none: No Steam, Epic, GOG or Ubisoft installation was detected.
game_saves_ui.view_pc_desc: Saves found on this PC. Select games and press Back up.
game_saves_ui.view_backup_desc: What your backup folder holds. Select games and press Restore to put their saves back on this PC.
game_saves_ui.backup_view_no_folder: Choose a backup folder above to see what it holds.
game_saves_ui.backup_view_empty: Nothing is backed up yet. Select games in the "On this PC" tab and press Back up.
game_saves_ui.list_more: Showing the first {count}. Search to narrow the list.
game_saves_ui.empty_not_scanned: Press Scan to look for game saves on this PC.
game_saves_ui.scanning_first: Looking for saves… The first scan also downloads the game save database (about 17 MB).
game_saves_ui.empty_none: No game saves were found on this PC.
game_saves_ui.unsupported: Game Saves works on Windows only.
game_saves_ui.suggestions_desc: These folders look like game saves but are not in the database. Add the ones you want backed up.
game_saves_ui.suggestion_added: Added. Scanning again to include it…
game_saves_ui.suggestion_gone: This suggestion is no longer available. Scan again.
game_saves_ui.nothing_to_restore: None of the selected games has a backup.
game_saves_ui.busy: Another game saves task is already running.
game_saves_ui.game_gone: This game is no longer in the list. Scan again.
game_saves_ui.error_cloud_unavailable: OneDrive could not provide or store this file. It may be online-only while OneDrive is paused, signed out or closed. Start OneDrive, or set the folder to “Always keep on this device”, and try again.
game_saves_ui.error_in_use: The file is in use. Close the game and try again.
game_saves_ui.steam_cloud_active_hint: Steam syncs this save folder (steam_autocloud.vdf is in it).
game_saves_ui.group_steam_cloud_desc: Steam already keeps these saves in its cloud, so a backup here is optional.
game_saves_ui.group_backup_only_desc: Restore them to put each game's saves back where the game looks for them.
game_saves_ui.group_different_desc: Restoring replaces the saves on this PC with the backup. The replaced saves are kept in _before-restore first.
game_saves_ui.group_same_desc: These saves match the backup, so there is nothing to restore.
game_saves_ui.files_pc_only: {count} file(s) on this PC are not in the backup. Restoring leaves them as they are.
game_saves_ui.file_pc_newer_hint: Restoring replaces this newer file. The current one is kept in _before-restore.
game_saves_ui.restore_done_safety: Restored {files} item(s). The saves that were replaced are kept in _before-restore.
game_saves_ui.restore_confirm_detail: Close these games first. The saves currently on this PC are copied to _before-restore in the backup folder before anything is overwritten.
game_saves_ui.restore_confirm_newer: This PC has newer saves than the backup for: {games}.
game_saves_ui.restore_confirm_cloud: Cloud saves are on for: {games}. The launcher may replace the restored files with its own cloud copy.
game_saves_ui.progress_detect: Looking for Steam, Epic, GOG and Ubisoft…

ui.dns_help: Clears remembered website addresses. Try it when a website cannot be found even though you are connected.
ui.ip_help: Requests a fresh local IP address from your router. Useful when your PC cannot connect to the network.
ui.bluetooth_help: Restarts Bluetooth services. Try it when pairing or device discovery stops working.
ui.reset_help: Resets Windows networking settings. Use after simpler connection fixes have not helped.
ui.disk_help: Checks drive C: for file system errors without repairing them. Administrator access is required.
ui.audio_help: Restarts Windows audio services. Useful when sound stops working despite the correct volume and output device.
ui.sfc_help: Checks and repairs protected Windows files. Useful when Windows features fail. Requires administrator access and may take several minutes.
ui.dism_help: Repairs the Windows component store used for system repairs. Useful if SFC cannot fix a problem. Requires administrator access and may need internet access.

ui.audio_warning: Audio playback will be interrupted temporarily.
ui.cleaner_help: Scan first to see what can be removed, then select the categories to clean. Review Recycle Bin contents before emptying it.
